patch_list: Readable day/agenda summaries and native Outlook/Exchange HTML preview with explicit source editing; preserves the original editor text.
Choose three separate default reminders for new all-day events in Calendar settings. Keeps timed-event defaults, existing events and the use-last-reminders setting.
